blocks.text: Yeh roundworms (gol keere) hain, jin ka jism lamba, keere jaisa (gol) aur dono siron par nokeela hota hai. Kuch roundworms paani aur mitti mein aazad rehte hain, jaise Caenorhabditis elegans. Bohat se parasites hain, jaise ascaris, hookworm, pinworm aur whipworm.
Pseudocoelomates saat phyla mein baante gaye hain. In phyla ko mila kar ek unit banti hai jise Aschelminths kehte hain. Phylum Nematoda is group ka numainda (representative) phylum hai.

Roundworms triploblastic, bilaterally symmetrical aur unsegmented hain. Yeh pseudocoelomates hain, kyunke in mein ek jhooti body cavity, pseudocoelom, hoti hai jo fluid se bhari hoti hai. In ka digestive system tube jaisa hai: ek alimentary canal jis ke do soorakh hain, aage mouth aur peeche anus. Parasitic roundworms ka digestive system saada (simplified) hota hai. Excretory system protonephridia aur do excretory canals se bana hai; yeh canals aage ke sire par mil kar ek canal banati hain, jo pait ki satah (ventral surface) par ek nephridiopore se bahar khulti hai. Jism mein neurons ka jaal hai; pharynx ke gird ek nerve ring hoti hai jo chaar lambi nerve cords se juri hoti hai. Honton (lips) par baal jaise ubhre hue sense organs hote hain jinhein sensory papillae kehte hain. In mein waazeh respiratory aur circulatory systems nahi hote. Yeh unisexual hain, yani nar nematodes mein testes aur maada nematodes mein ovaries hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Upar: teen roundworms ke khaake, Ascaris (lamba, S jaisa), pinworm (lipta hua) aur Trichinella (lipta hua); Ascaris se neeche aam banawat ki taraf teer. Neeche: roundworm, aage mouth, phir pharynx, pharynx ke gird nerve ring, neeche ki satah par nephridiopore aur reproductive pore, jism ke saath intestine aur dum ke qareeb anus.

blocks.text: Roundworm ki nali jaisi digestive system ke do siray hain: aage mouth aur peeche anus. Mouth ke baad pharynx (jamni) aur phir lambi intestine (laal) hai. Pharynx ke gird neela chhalla nerve ring hai, jis se nerve cords nikalti hain. Excretory canal neeche ki satah par nephridiopore se khulti hai. Jism ke andar ki khaali jagah (pseudocoelom) mein fluid bhara hai.
